target_customer: Product and design teams that cannot interview customers often
problem: Teams lack fast customer feedback; Promi builds digital twins of existing customers from usage data for simulated interviews and walkthroughs.

founders.name: Peter Moot
founders.background_notes: Led product for discounts at Uber

founders.name: Jiaxin Lin
founders.background_notes: Recommendation and personalization systems in e-commerce; Uber core AI team per founder Q&A

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs LLM persona modeling grounded in product analytics integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Customer usage data connections help but synthetic research tooling is easy to copy.

market_need_then: Teams cannot afford frequent user research per the founders; no dated external evidence found.

branding.domain_note: Uses trypromi.com; aggregators also show usepromi.com

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; domain trypromi.com rather than an exact name .com.

outcome_analysis: Promi is a two person Summer 2024 company led by former Uber product and AI people, building digital twin customer personas. It is active with no later funding found, so there is no outcome to explain yet and early stage risk is the main story.
notes: A 500K September 2024 pre seed appears on aggregators only and matches the YC standard deal, so no round is recorded. Some aggregators describe Promi as price and discount optimization, an earlier or different description; a possible pivot is not confirmed. Competition at founding not found in dated sources.
